description.en: An adult-scale Camarasaurus reconstruction with a short boxy skull, stout neck and near-level shoulders and hips. This is a composite artistic reconstruction, not a scan of one individual; soft tissues and posture are inferred.
description.zh: 成年尺度的Camarasaurus复原，具有短方头骨、粗壮颈部与近水平的肩臀轮廓。属于综合美术复原，非单个体扫描；软组织与姿态为推断。

diagnostic_targets: Short deep boxy head with blunt rounded muzzle, not tapering long diplodocid skull.
Stout relatively compact neck, not Mamenchisaurus-like hyperelongation.
Broad ribcage, four weight-bearing columnar limbs; front limbs slightly shorter than hind limbs.
Near-level shoulder and hip line without elevated brachiosaur shoulder tower.
Complete tapering tail of moderate relative length; no spikes or armor.

scale.basis: NHMU genus estimate15–20m, use lower end; no scaled juvenile measurement claim.

scientific_limits.en: Adult-scale artistic reconstruction, not a scan of one individual. Adult skull CM12020 informs head shape; the illustrated Smithsonian body mount combines subadult USNM13786, separate tail USNM15492 and skull cast USNM369928 from DINO28. Do not treat juvenile CM11338 as an adult or copy the Apatosaurus body in panelD. Fifteen metres is a genus estimate, not a specimen measurement. Neck posture, soft tissue and colour inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 成年尺度的属级完整美术复原，不是单一个体扫描。成年颅骨CM12020支持头形；史密森身体装架为亚成体USNM13786、不同个体尾部USNM15492及来自DINO28的颅模USNM369928拼合。不得把幼体CM11338当成年，也不得复制D图雷龙类Apatosaurus身体。15米为属级估值，非标本实测。颈姿态、软组织及颜色属推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete adult genus-level sauropod reconstruction retaining short boxy skull, stout neck and near-level shoulder-hip line. Not a long-snouted diplodocid or high-shouldered brachiosaur.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed NPS2021Fig1; adult CM12020 skull panelE, composite subadult skeleton panelsB/C, juvenile panelA clearly separated; panelD is Apatosaurus body wearing historical wrong skull and excluded.
